text:
Type: geometric abstract canvas print
Use: wall decoration above a sofa or bed; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: contemporary, modern
Materials: printed canvas, silver metallic frame
Colors: white, aqua, black, grey, blush pink, cobalt blue accents
Shape: large square, thin silver float frame, layered angled triangles and fragments, busy composition
Feel: fresh, lively, airy
Goes with: white or grey walls, aqua or blush accents, chrome; modern or glam rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Geometric Aqua and Black Angled Canvas Print in Silver Frame, 31.75" x 31.75"
product.description: This striking series of geometric shapes gives a contemporary flair to your room. Aqua and black forms, mixed with a few accent colors, create an eclectic, modern piece that is housed in a silver floater frame for a sophisticated look. Contemporary geometric shapes Hand-stretched canvas around engineered wood stretcher bar with floater frame in a silver finish; arrives ready to hang 31.75" x 31.75" Made to order
